assets.name: Fixed stone bridge with authored riverbanks and dressing
assets.notes: v002 locally reviewed candidate released in Releases/Bridge_Stone_A/v002. Fixed 10.8m bridge, 2.86m clear path; Y-up road Z and river X. Structural LODs 13598/7704/1736 triangles; separate dressing 12428/5022/80. 286-triangle collision. Two flags seated on right-hand entrance stone caps. FBX roundtrip, packed texture and Cycles/Eevee visual checks passed. Opt-in Unity fixed-site generation contract implemented/tested; art import, global water/socket integration and in-game visual approval remain pending. v001 preserved.
